commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Ricardo Pepi (USA) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90+9' Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
90+8' Ermin Mahmic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
90+6' Alex Freeman (USA) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
90+5' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Reyna (USA) will replace Weston McKennie.
90+2' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
90+1' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Amar Memic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) inside the box.
88' Mauricio Pochettino prepares a substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Ricardo Pepi (USA).
87' Sergino Dest goes off the pitch and Sebastian Berhalter (USA) comes on.
82' 2 - 0 Malik Tillman (USA) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the left post.
81' USA earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
80' Stjepan Radeljic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
80' Referee Raphael Claus has finally had enough of Sergej Barbarez and brandishes a yellow card at him!
80' The attendance for today's match is 68827.
79' A goal, which was scored by Christian Pulisic (USA), was disallowed due to offside.
79' Malik Tillman (USA) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
77' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
75' Here comes a substitution. Nikola Katic is given a rest as he is replaced by Amar Memic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
75' Here is a change. Sead Kolasinac is going off and Sergej Barbarez gives the last tactical orders to Haris Tabakovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
74' Esmir Bajraktarevic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
69' The referee blows for a cooling break.
69' Amar Dedic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) tackles a bit over-zealously and Raphael Claus blows for a foul.
68' The attempt by Esmir Bajraktarevic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) isn't very precise and Matt Freese stops it with ease.

66' Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Matt Freese who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
64' RED card! Folarin Balogun (USA) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

63' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Folarin Balogun (USA), but referee Raphael Claus must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
61' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
61' The game is interrupted now, Folarin Balogun (USA) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Weston McKennie (USA) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
56' Nikola Katic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
53' Malik Tillman (USA) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
51' Ermin Mahmic comes onto the pitch because Edin Dzeko (Bosnia & Herzegovina) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
51' Sergej Barbarez has decided to substitute Ivan Sunjic and he is replaced by Benjamin Tahirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
51' Substitution. Armin Gigovic did his best and is replaced by Esmir Bajraktarevic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).

49' Chris Richards (USA) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
48' Good work from USA as they win a corner.
48' Christian Pulisic (USA) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+11' The end of the first half.
45+9' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+8' Folarin Balogun (USA) blows a clear opportunity to score as he rattles the crossbar from point-blank range.
45+5' Tyler Adams (USA) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+2' Tyler Adams (USA) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Folarin Balogun (USA) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
42' Folarin Balogun (USA) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails miles wide of the right post!

41' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Raphael Claus blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to USA.
40' Christian Pulisic (USA) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
38' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Folarin Balogun (USA).
37' Weston McKennie (USA) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
36' Tarik Muharemovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) sends a long ball in, but Matt Freese comfortably gathers the ball.
31' Folarin Balogun (USA) has a goal ruled out for offside!
31' Sergino Dest (USA) commits a foul and Raphael Claus immediately signals a free kick.
29' Folarin Balogun (USA) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
27' Antonee Robinson (USA) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Raphael Claus has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' The corner from Malik Tillman (USA) is intercepted by Nikola Vasilj.
20' Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' The game is interrupted now, Nikola Vasilj (Bosnia & Herzegovina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' Antonee Robinson (USA) is inside the box in a promising position to head home! His poor header flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
15' Folarin Balogun (USA) takes a first-time shot from inside the box, but his poor effort flies way wide of the right post.
15' The free kick is taken by Malik Tillman (USA), but ball is cleared.

14' The game is interrupted. Sead Kolasinac (Bosnia & Herzegovina) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick to USA.
11' Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) whips in a cross from the corner, but Matt Freese is well positioned and punches the ball away.

10' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Matt Freese easily catches the ball.
8' The foul by Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) was seen by Raphael Claus who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' Malik Tillman (USA) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
5' Weston McKennie (USA) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. USA will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' USA quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

4' Christian Pulisic (USA) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. USA win a corner kick.
2' The corner is swung in but Bosnia & Herzegovina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bosnia & Herzegovina will have the kick-off.
Raphael Claus is introduced as the referee for today's match.
